svg.desc: Programmers use client libraries for Python, Rust, Go, and TypeScript to talk to Qdrant. Qdrant storage holds collections 1, 2, and 3, using Euclidean distance, dot product, and cosine similarity. Collection 2 expands into points, each made of an idx, a vector, and a payload p; the payload holds fields such as species, URL, color, and fluffiness. Below, ML engineers use data and Python files to train a deep learning model that classifies images as husky, cat, or hairy coo; Qdrant storage connects to that model.

g.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
